passages.title: Learn Emotions in English
passages.description: 通过图片学习各种表情的英语表达

content.title: This face is happy.
content.text:
Happy

This face is happy.
When you are happy, you smile and feel good.

content.title: This face is sad.
content.text:
Sad

This face is sad.
When you are sad, you might cry or feel down.

content.title: This face is sorry.
content.text:
Sorry

This face is sorry.
When you are sorry, you feel bad about something you did.

content.title: This face is excited.
content.text:
Excited

This face is excited.
When you are excited, you feel very happy about something that will happen.

content.title: This face is scared.
content.text:
Scared

This face is scared.
When you are scared, you are afraid of something.

content.title: This face is shy.
content.text:
Shy

This face is shy.
When you are shy, you feel nervous around other people.

content.title: This face is mad.
content.text:
Mad

This face is mad.
When you are mad, you are very angry.

content.title: This face is sleepy.
content.text:
Sleepy

This face is sleepy.
When you are sleepy, you need to rest or go to bed.
